subject: NetLink Router RTR-0091-01 completely offline at Chromepet store
description: The NetLink NL-3000 v2.2 router at our Chromepet location has gone completely offline since approximately 6:00 PM today. All wireless connectivity is unavailable, affecting both customer Wi-Fi and back-office operations. The router shows no lights and is unresponsive to power cycling attempts. This is impacting POS systems and customer service at the store.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. L1 agent confirmed router is not responding to ping attempts and requested store manager to verify power connections and restart sequence.
